name: Band Wall Walk
steps: Place a small resistance loop band around your wrists or forearms.
Stand facing a smooth wall with elbows bent at 90 degrees and forearms resting vertically against the wall at chest height.
Pull your wrists outward to create continuous outward tension on the band.
Maintaining that outward tension, slowly 'walk' your forearms upward along the wall in small alternating steps until your arms are nearly fully extended.
Walk your forearms back down in small controlled steps to chest height.
coaching_cues: Keep continuous outward tension on the band; do not let your hands cave inward.
Keep your core braced so your lower back does not arch as your hands climb higher.
Move with tiny, deliberate hand steps.

sources.attribution: Cornell Health Shoulder Band Strengthening Protocol
